source_unavailable: The current main chat is unavailable. Reconnect before switching models.
busy: Wait for the main chat to finish and resolve its pending questions and queued messages before switching models.
invalid_pick: Choose a provider and a valid reasoning effort.
unknown_runtime: The chat engine could not be confirmed. Refresh before switching models.
atomic_store: This hub cannot save a main-chat handoff atomically. Update the hub before switching engines.
target_changed: The new chat did not start with the selected provider. The current main chat was kept.
